audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows contradict the packet and, again, contradict the whys printed beside them: whys[1] and whys[2] say you out-trade him at 2-3 while win[1]/win[2] say Gragas; whys[3] and whys[4] say Gragas tanks your burst and flips the all-in while win[3]/win[4] say Skill; whys[6] says you outscale him while win[6] says Gragas.
audit.why: Packet chart: Skill, Wukong, Wukong, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Wukong, and the gragas__wukong mirror is already set to it. Win rate 54.07% over 172 games with an early and a late window fits that shape.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs; ratings raised to 6/10 on the rows you now own.

audit.why: Gragas spikes at Body Slam rank-ups (14/13.5/13/12.5/12s), level 6 Explosive Cask (100/85/70s), and health/AP items that make Drunken Rage's damage cut matter. Wukong's windows are levels 2-3 before Body Slam is reliable, and the two-item dive.
audit.corrected: Chart sides realigned to those spikes; spike text kept, with the W description corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Drunken Rage a shield in five places — whys[3] 'Drunken Rage's shield', spikes[1] 'Drunken Rage (W) shielding', spikes[2] 'plus his shield', mid 'shield-and-steroid', wants.foe[1] 'Drunken Rage (W) shield'. Drunken Rage grants no shield. It is a 1-second drink that empowers his next basic attack with magic damage and REDUCES DAMAGE RECEIVED, on a flat 5s cooldown, and the kit flags it as an auto reset.
audit.why: Riot's W text verbatim: 'Gragas samples his latest brew for 1 second. After finishing, he becomes boisterous and belligerent, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies on his next basic attack and reducing damage received.' cd 5. The distinction matters for the all-in maths — a shield can be burst through, a damage cut applies to everything and is never on cooldown in practice.
audit.corrected: Drunken Rage is a damage cut plus an auto reset on a 5s cooldown, not a shield. Body Slam (E) stuns at 600 range, 14s at rank 1 — that is the ability with a punishable cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Body Slam is named as the tracked cooldown page-wide without its number, and the page implies Drunken Rage is a resource to bait when it is up every 5 seconds.
audit.why: Body Slam 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s is the only long cooldown in his laning kit; Drunken Rage at 5s is never meaningfully down.

audit.whatIsWrong: Happy Hour is never mentioned anywhere on the page, yet the itemization line already tells you to buy Executioner's Calling for 'his healing'.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: 'Gragas periodically heals upon using a skill', flagged heal. That is what the anti-heal buy is for, and the page never connects the two.
audit.corrected: Named in spikes[2] alongside the Grievous Wounds timing.

notes: Two findings. (1) The packet's suspectNames flags 'Drunken Rage's' and 'Use Drunken Rage' as probable wrong names — both are FALSE POSITIVES, the name is correct. But the matcher pointed at the right sentences for the wrong reason: those lines call Drunken Rage a SHIELD, and it grants no shield. Riot's text gives an empowered next basic attack plus reduced damage received, on a flat 5s cooldown, with an auto-reset flag. Corrected in whys[3], spikes[1], spikes[2], mid and wants.foe[1]. (2) The level chart disagreed with the packet at five rows and with the page's own whys at all five; flipped in matched pairs to match the gragas__wukong mirror. Also connected Happy Hour to the anti-heal buy the itemization line already recommends without ever explaining.
